note: Display switches for the Answers Over Time pages (archive_pages.py). They change what the PAGES show, never what is recorded: archive.json keeps every question and answer. `hidden`: ids of recorded questions (Q01, T004, C003 ...) to leave off the public pages, their share cards and the data files; when any is listed, every page's footer says "Some recorded questions are not shown." Empty by default: everything is shown. `political`: ids of questions flagged as political; a page that shows one carries the footer line "This site does not promote hate." Only the owner edits this file.
